journey.intro: Hi, I'm Arroba Copilot ✦. I'm going to ask you a few questions to understand what you'd like to do and set up your workspace. Don't worry if you don't have all the answers yet — you can complete them later.
journey.q1: To start, what would you like to do?
journey.q2: Tell me a bit about you so I can tailor what I propose.
journey.vehicleHint: Search your company by name or tax ID, or type it if you don't have one yet.
journey.companyHint: I'll automatically build its profile from our database.
journey.vehicleQ: From which company or vehicle would you make the acquisitions?
journey.companyQ: Tell me your company's legal name or tax ID.
journey.exploreBranch: Perfect. I'll let you explore freely. First, what should we call your workspace?
journey.confirmTitle: I found this company in our database. Please confirm it's yours before we continue.
journey.preparing: Thanks. With this I can prepare your summary.
journey.summaryFootnote: You can review and complete every detail later, no rush.
journey.successBodyExplore: Your personal workspace is created. You can start exploring now.
journey.errorCommit: We couldn't create your workspace. Please try again.
journey.errorTaxIdDuplicate: An organisation with that tax ID already exists.
